title: Surface annotation document
description: Declarative presentation for one subject schema. Presentation only: no components, no code, no constraints. See docs/annotation.md.

subject.description: The subject schema's $id (or documentUri when it has no $id).

targetLibraries.description: Optional kit/library identifiers this annotation targets (e.g. @rusl-labs/surface-html). Metadata for tooling and kit authors; core does not filter renderers on this field.

views.description: Named views; `default` is the fallback view.

defs.description: Per-def view blocks; defs.<name> targets #/$defs/<name>, applying at every use site.

fieldLayout.description: How bound fields are chrome'd in this view/section. props = label|value rows (default). stack = full-width blocks (heroes, cards).

fieldDirection.description: Flow of the section/view body. vertical = column (default). horizontal = row (wrap). Intended with layout stack; props stays a definition list internally.

blockEntry.description: Structural block chrome. Discriminated by kind:block.

template.description: Optional interpolated prose inside the chrome (same rules as templateEntry).

bannerEntry.description: Full-bleed banner chrome. Discriminated by kind:banner.

spanEntry.description: Inline span chrome for short prose or nested fields. Discriminated by kind:span.

name.description: A single literal property name of the containing object. Never dotted, never a pointer; nesting is expressed with `fields`.

label.description: null clears a key inherited from the default view or a ref target.

hidden.description: Present but not shown; participates and submits.

omit.description: Not part of the presentation at all.

view.description: Requested view for the child Surface; flows to descendants.

itemLabel.description: Array entries: singular noun for add/remove/empty affordances.

addLabel.description: Visible caption on the collection add control. Omit for icon-only. `{{path}}` interpolates over this node's data (HTML-escaped). Does not replace itemLabel (still used for remove a11y).

items.description: Array entries: describes the item node (inline item objects). For $ref items, chrome merges over the target; fields is ignored.

fields.description: Nested literal object layout. Ignored on $ref entries (use-site chrome only).

label.description: Section heading. Empty string = anonymous group (layout only, no heading).

widget.description: Kit treatment for the group (e.g. danger, collapsible). Unknown treatment degrades to a plain section.

fields.description: Omit for a flat heading. A section with no visible children contributes nothing.

template.description: Handlebars-style key access over the containing object's data; keys may be dotted ({{actor.name}}). Always HTML-escaped. No expressions, no formatting pipes, no code. Missing keys or segments interpolate empty.

rest.description: Placement slot for unlisted properties. Design rule: at most one per OBJECT SCOPE (sections transparent) — the schema can only check per list. Absent means they land at the end.

modeOverride.description: Decoration keys only — layout (fields/rest/items) is per-view, not per-mode. `null` clears an inherited key. `hidden` applies to schema-bound entries only; virtual entries use `omit`.

widget.description: Kit-facing presentation attachment. The envelope owns name / $kind / options only. When `$kind` is set, the **entire** widget value is an instance of that kit schema (default HTML kit: packages/html/schemas/default-kit.schema.json#/$defs/<kind>). Extra properties are allowed on the object itself; `options` is an optional nested bag. Without `$kind`, treat as an open grab-bag for the named renderer. Core does not validate $kind.

name.description: Short widget name; candidate key `widget:<name>` (fallback after `$kind`).

$kind.description: Absolute URI of the schema (or def) this widget object conforms to. Candidate key for renderer resolution; takes precedence over `name`. Core does not validate — kits and tooling do.

options.description: Optional nested param bag. Kinds may prefer top-level properties on `widget` instead; both are open.

rest.description: Unlisted properties: append (schema order, default) or omit entirely.
